entities.name: CVE-2023-3519
entities.evidence: threat actors exploited this vulnerability as a zero-day to drop a webshell on a critical infrastructure organization

entities.name: SECRETSAUCE
entities.evidence: One third party observed the actors deploy the SECRETSAUCE webshell

entities.name: LIGOLO-NG
entities.evidence: Deployed LIGOLO-NG [5] tunneller with the filename the in the /tmp directory

entities.name: NPS
entities.evidence: Deployed the NPS tunneller [6] to victim networks to the /tmp directory

entities.name: ADExplorer
entities.evidence: Used Sysinternals ADExplorer, a Microsoft tool for viewing and editing the AD

entities.name: Compromise Infrastructure
entities.evidence: The threat actors appear to have used compromised pfSense devices to proxy C2 traffic to Victim 2

entities.name: Obtain Capabilities: Tool
entities.evidence: The threat actors leveraged open source webshells [2] [4] and other publicly available tools

entities.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
entities.evidence: The threat actors exploited CVE-2023-3519 to implant a webshell on the organization

entities.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter: Unix Shell
entities.evidence: The threat actors executed /bin/sh as root

entities.name: Native API
entities.evidence: The threat actors executed /bin/sh via syscall

entities.name: Boot or Logon Autostart Execution
entities.evidence: Threat actors used /flash/nsconfig/rc.netscaler rewrite a webshell on every reboot

entities.name: Server Software Component: Web Shell
entities.evidence: The threat actors implanted a generic webshell on the organization

entities.name: Abuse Elevation Control Mechanism: Setuid and Setgid
entities.evidence: the threat actors uploaded a TGZ file contain a setuid binary on the ADC appliance

entities.name: Deobfuscate/Decode Files or Information
entities.evidence: decrypt it using an internally embedded RSA public key [T1140]

entities.name: File and Directory Permissions Modification: Linux and Mac Permissions
entities.evidence: Permissions Modification T1222.002 The threat actors appended /flash/nsconfig/rc.netscaler

entities.name: Indicator Removal
entities.evidence: Indicator Removal T1070 The threat actors deleted log files from Victim 2

entities.name: Indicator Removal: Clear Linux or Mac System Logs
entities.evidence: as some access logs, error logs, and authentication logs [T1070.002]

entities.name: Indicator Removal: File Deletion
entities.evidence: The threat actors deleted collected files after exfiltrating them

entities.name: Masquerading
entities.evidence: The actor has used the following file names for SECRETSAUCE to appear legitimate

entities.name: Masquerading: Match Legitimate Resource Name or Location
entities.evidence: The threat actors named a webshell *logouttm.php*

entities.name: Masquerading: Masquerade File Type
entities.evidence: The threat actors exfiltrated data by uploading it as an image file to a web-accessible path

entities.name: Unsecured Credentials: Credentials In Files
entities.evidence: The threat actors obtained encrypted passwords from NetScaler ADC configuration files

entities.name: Unsecured Credentials: Private Keys
entities.evidence: The threat actors obtained decryption keys to decrypt the AD credential

entities.name: Domain Trust Discovery
entities.evidence: The threat actors queried the AD for trusts

entities.name: Permission Groups Discovery: Domain Groups
entities.evidence: The threat actors quired the AD for groups

entities.name: Remote System Discovery
entities.evidence: The threat actors queried the AD for computers

entities.name: System Network Configuration Discovery
entities.evidence: The actors used a webshell for AD enumeration

entities.name: System Network Configuration Discovery: Internet Connection Discovery
entities.evidence: The threat actors attempted to verify outbound network connectivity with a ping command

entities.name: Network Service Discovery
entities.evidence: The threat actors conducted SMB scanning on the organization

entities.name: Account Discovery: Domain Account
entities.evidence: The threat actors queried the AD for users

entities.name: Archive Collected Data: Archive via Utility
entities.evidence: The threat actors encrypted discovery data collected via openssl in

entities.name: Data from Local System
entities.evidence: The threat actors viewed NetScaler ADC configuration files

entities.name: Data Staged
entities.evidence: Exfiltrated collected data by uploading as an image file [T1036.008] to a web-accessible path [T1074]

entities.name: Data Staged: Local Data Staging
entities.evidence: The threat actors modified tool wrote captured credentials to a file created in a hard-coded path

entities.name: Encrypted Channel: Asymmetric Cryptography
entities.evidence: The threat actors deployed LIGOLO-NG, which is a tunneller that provides encrypted reverse TCP/TLS connections

entities.name: Ingress Tool Transfer
entities.evidence: The threat actors exploited CVE-2023-3519 to upload a TGZ file containing a generic webshell

entities.name: Protocol Tunneling
entities.evidence: The threat actors deployed LIGOLO-NG and NPS tunnellers

entities.name: Proxy: Internal Proxy
entities.evidence: The actors likely used a PHP shell with proxying capability to attempt proxying SMB traffic to the DC

entities.name: Proxy: Multi-hop Proxy
entities.evidence: the victim observed communications with two pfSense IP addresses indicating the actor was using them for multi-hop proxying C2 traffic

entities.name: Account Access Removal
entities.evidence: The threat actors deleted the authorization configuration file
